description: This Java test class 'TelemetryMqttQoS1IT' is an integration test for the Eclipse Hono project, specifically testing MQTT telemetry data upload with QoS 1. It extends a base test class 'MqttPublishTestBase', overrides methods for sending telemetry data and creating consumers, and utilizes MQTT client and Vert.x components.

classes.name: TelemetryMqttQoS1IT
classes.description: An integration test class for MQTT telemetry upload with QoS 1 in the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Overrides method to publish telemetry data to MQTT topic with provided tenant and device IDs, payload, and optional short topic name.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Overrides method to create and return a telemetry message consumer for a specific tenant.
